channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nik Stauskas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nik Stauskas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Nik Stauskas
item.description:
“Respecting everyone on the court. Hell, Stauskas gets 18 points in the first half. Just having our antennas up and taking more pride defensively.”

Rajon Rondo on Nik Stauskas, Oct 19, 2018. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: George Karl on Nik Stauskas
item.description:
Bill Herenda:Karl on Stauskas:

“I think we gotta get Nik some minutes . he’s gotta get on court to get some confidence, rhythm”

George Karl on Nik Stauskas, Feb 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @billherenda.

item.title: Brett Brown on Andrew Wiggins, Nik Stauskas
item.description:
Keith Pompey:Brett Brown on Andrew Wiggins pre draft:

“I thought we had him. I was expecting we were going to draft Stauskas and Wiggins.”

Brett Brown on Andrew Wiggins, Nik Stauskas, Dec 3, 2014. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.
